bear_case.summary: AMP's earnings are a levered bet on equity markets near highs (S&P ~7,776): client assets $1.2T up 15% largely from appreciation, record EPS. Asset management still bleeds ($5.9B outflows Q2), advisor attrition (Comerica) continues, and cash sweep economics are rate-sensitive. A market drawdown hits fees, spread and buyback capacity at once.
risks: Equity market drawdown cuts asset-based fees
Cash sweep / certificate spread compression and regulatory scrutiny of sweep rates
